title: Annual report.
bodyText: The department shall submit a report of the actions taken under this chapter which shall be included in the annual report pursuant to section 201-10.
bodyHtml: [§210D-14]  Annual report.  The department shall submit a report of the actions taken under this chapter which shall be included in the annual report pursuant to section 201-10. [L 1990, c 111, pt of §2]
